title: Add an explicit LOOSE/HELD/IN_FLIGHT possession model to a deterministic match sim without changing soccer
derivation: sunday-league PR #19 (merged; stage 3 of specs/projects/sunday-league/multi-sport-core.md) added sim/possession.gd and taught MatchSim to carry a HELD ball (skip ball physics, pin it ahead of the holder at carry height with the holder's velocity, skip the touch models, drop it if the holder vanishes), cleared possession on soccer restarts and added a carry tuning section; soccer's seed-42 digest was unchanged. Graded as a faithful TypeScript port, extending the orchestrate-sl-sim-phase-one port (d682688 plus the #18 ball-physics fix): the rest of #18 at base_ref bfef6bd is ported function-by-function (dribble.gd, sport_rules.gd, sports/soccer_rules.gd, the MatchSim rules seam, dribble wiring, reload_tuning) and data/tuning.json and docs/multi-sport-core.md are the exact base_ref bytes. possession.ts is a one-line stub (a new file in the PR). The reference ports #19 line-for-line (possession.ts, match_sim.ts, soccer_rules.ts restart clear) with the exact merged tuning.json; port notes as in the orchestrate package (vec.ts semantics, PCG32 SimRng, djb2 digest), and GDScript's Possession.State enum becomes a const PossessionState object. TASK.md states the PR's model, including set_loose/release keeping team for a negative argument, the carry formula, defaults 0.45/1.0, and that IN_FLIGHT is physically identical to LOOSE. Hidden checks drive sim.possession directly with held-out seeds, tuning and inputs: object transitions, carry pose every tick (to 1e-6), defaults, touch skipping with an opponent kicking on the ball, vanished carrier, fumble momentum, IN_FLIGHT vs LOOSE path identity and reception, restarts, and soccer preservation (three AI-match digests that stay neutral LOOSE, and the seed-42 log hash), whose expected values are the base port's own.
coverage: 11 rows: possession object (2), carrying (4), release/restart (3), soccer preservation (2).
residual_rubric: Comment wording and any self-tests are not graded; the architecture.md rewording of the never-parented rule is outside this slice.
leak_tokens: Pin the ball to its carrier
required_environment: Original: Godot 4 headless + gdUnit4 (game/tests/sim/test_possession.gd). Packaged: node 24 type stripping (michael-replay-grader-node:mb008) on the faithful TS port.
